title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — declarations on packages (principal rules)
content: Text of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 as first published in the Gazette of India (G.S.R. 202(E), 7 March 2011). Passages are quoted as printed; quotation marks are normalised. Some of this text was later amended — the amendment records in this category give the changes, and a requirement must use the amended text where one exists. Rule 6(1): "Every package shall bear thereon or on label securely affixed thereto, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration made in accordance with the provisions of this chapter as, to-" Rule 6(1)(a): "the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned" Rule 6(1)(a), Explanation I: "If any name and address of a company is mentioned on the label without any qualifying words 'manufactured by' or 'packed by', it shall be presumed that such name and address shall be that of the manufacturer and the liability shall be determined accordingly;" Rule 6(1)(b): "The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be mentioned on the package." Rule 6(1)(c): "The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned." Rule 6(1)(d): "The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned in the package:" First proviso to Rule 6(1)(d): "Provided that for packages containing food articles, the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 (37 of 1954) and the rules made there under shall apply:" Rule 6(1)(e): "the retail sale price of the package;" Rule 6(1), Explanation I: "The month and the year in which commodity is pre-packed may be expressed either in words, or by numerals indicating the month and the year, or by both." Rule 13(4): "No number called the dozen, score, gross, great gross or the like shall be specified or indicated on any package" Rule 13(5): "(i) No system of units other than the International System of Units shall be used in furnishing the net quantity of the package;" and "(ii) For items sold by number the symbol should be N or U."
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — G.S.R. 202(E), Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 7 March 2011
reference: Rule 6(1)(a)–(e) and Explanation I (Gazette pp. 42–46); Rule 13(4)–(5) (p. 55)

title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2012 — food articles refer to the Food Safety and Standards Act
content: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2012 (G.S.R. 427(E), 5 June 2012) changed the food-article references in Rule 6(1) of the principal rules. Quoted as printed, quotation marks normalised: "in rule 6,- (i) in sub-rule (1), for the words "Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (37 of 1954)" the words "Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006)" shall be substituted;" As a result, for packages containing food articles, the month-and-year declaration of Rule 6(1)(d) is governed by the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the rules made under it.
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2012 — G.S.R. 427(E), Gazette of India, 5 June 2012
reference: Rule 2(b)(i) of the amendment (substitution in Rule 6(1))

title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Amendment) Rules, 2015 — consumer complaint contact details
content: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Amendment) Rules, 2015 (G.S.R. 385(E), 14 May 2015). Quoted as printed, quotation marks normalised. It substituted Rule 6(2) with effect from 1 January 2016: "(2) Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints." It also substituted Rule 2(bb): "(bb) "industrial consumer" means the consumer who buys packaged commodities directly from the manufacturer or from an importer or from wholesale dealer for use by that industry and the package shall have declaration 'not for retail sale';" It inserted Rule 6(9): "(9) Without prejudice to the provisions contained in this rule, it shall be permissible to affix a label on imported packages for making the declarations required under these rules."
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Amendment) Rules, 2015 — G.S.R. 385(E), Gazette of India, 14 May 2015
reference: Rule 3(i) of the amendment (Rule 6(2) substituted w.e.f. 1 January 2016); Rule 3(ii) (Rule 6(9) inserted); Rule 2(i) (Rule 2(bb) substituted)

title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017 — scope, MRP form, food articles, country of origin, best before
content: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017 (G.S.R. 629(E), 23 June 2017), in force from 1 January 2018. Quoted as printed, quotation marks normalised. Rule 2(bc) substituted: "(bc) "institutional consumer" means the institution which buys packaged commodities bearing a declaration 'not for retail sale', directly from the manufacturer or from an importer or from wholesale dealer for use by that institution and not for commercial or trade purposes;" Rule 2(m) substituted: "(m) "retail sale price" means the maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer inclusive of all taxes;" Rule 3 substituted: "3. Application of Chapter.- The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to- (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kilogram or 25 litre; (b) cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kilogram; and (c) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers." Rule 6(1)(a), Explanation III substituted: "Explanation III. - In respect of packages containing food articles, the provisions of this clause shall not apply, but the provisions of, and the requirements specified in the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006) and the rules made thereunder shall apply;" Rule 6(1)(aa) inserted: "(aa) The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package;" Rule 6(1)(da) inserted: "(da) If a package contains a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before or use by the date, month and year' shall also be mentioned on the label:" In Rule 6(1)(e), after the words "the retail sale price of the package;", these words were inserted: "shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes and the price in rupees and paise be rounded off to the nearest rupee or 50 paise;" followed by illustrations (later replaced in 2021). Rule 7(2) substituted: "(2) The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration required under these rules shall be as per Table-I." Rule 10(1), Explanation 1: "'complete address' means, the postal address at which the factory is situated or company or firm is registered, and, in any other case, the name of the street, number (if any) assigned to the premises of the manufacturer or packer or importer and the name of the city and State where the business is carried on by the manufacturer or packer or importer and the Postal Index Number [PIN] Code so that a consumer can identify and locate the manufacturer or packer or importer, as the case may be."
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017 — G.S.R. 629(E), Gazette of India, 23 June 2017 (in force 1 January 2018)

title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021 — month and year of manufacture, MRP in Indian currency
content: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021 (G.S.R. 779(E), 2 November 2021), in force from 1 April 2022. Quoted as printed, quotation marks normalised. "In the said rules, in rule 6, in sub-rule (1),-- (i) in clause (d), the words, "or pre-packed or imported" shall be omitted;" so that Rule 6(1)(d) requires the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured. "(ii) in clause (e), for the words commencing with "and the price in rupees and paisa", and ending with "(d) MRP Rs. ₹ xx.xx(inclusive of all taxes):", the words "in Indian currency:" shall be substituted;" so that the retail sale price declaration shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency. Rule 13(5)(ii) substituted: "(ii) for items sold by number, the number or unit or piece or pair or set or such other word which represents the quantity in the package shall be mentioned."
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021 — G.S.R. 779(E), Gazette of India, 2 November 2021 (in force 1 April 2022)

title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2022 — unit sale price
content: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2022 (G.S.R. 226(E), 28 March 2022; its commencement date was moved by later notifications). Quoted as printed. Rule 6(11) substituted: "(11) The unit sale price in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal place, shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodities in the following manner, namely:-" per gram or kilogram, per centimetre or metre, per millilitre or litre, or per number or unit. Second proviso: "Provided further that declaration of unit sale price is not required for the pre-packaged commodities in which retail sale price is equal to the unit sale price."
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2022 — G.S.R. 226(E), Gazette of India, 28 March 2022

title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025 — medical devices
content: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 778(E), 23 October 2025). Quoted as printed. A proviso was inserted to Rule 2(h): "Provided that for packages containing medical devices, the provisions of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, shall apply to make declarations;"
source_organization: Legal Metrology Division, Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
document_name: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025 — G.S.R. 778(E), Gazette of India, 23 October 2025
reference: Rule 2 of the amendment (proviso to Rule 2(h))
